Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.VirtualView
it.polimi.ingsw.network.socket.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateObserver, Runnable
public class SocketClientHandler extends VirtualView implements Runnable
Virtual view implementation that serves a single socket client: reads incoming JSON commands in its own thread and writes serialized DTOs back to the client, also handling the ping/pong heartbeat.
